title: Get Participation Data from Austrian Parliament — get_participation
text: function sends request Austrian Parliament's API retrieve participation data based provided filter criteria. performs input validation parameter constructs API request accordingly. Valid values topic: "Arbeit" (Labor) "Außenpolitik" (Foreign Policy) "Bildung" (Education) "Budget und Finanzen" (Budget Finance) "Europäische Union" (European Union) "Familie und Generationen" (Family Generations) "Frauen und Gleichbehandlung" (Women Equal Treatment) "Gesundheit und Ernährung" (Health Nutrition) "Information und Medien" (Information Media) "Inneres und Recht" (Interior Justice) "Innovation, Technologie und Forschung" (Innovation, Technology Research) "Klima, Umwelt und Energie" (Climate, Environment Energy) "Kultur" (Culture) "Land- und Forstwirtschaft" (Agriculture Forestry) "Landesverteidigung" (National Defense) "Parlament und Demokratie" (Parliament Democracy) "Soziales" (Social Affairs) "Sport" (Sports) "Verkehr und Infrastruktur" (Transport Infrastructure) "Wirtschaft" (Economy) Setting topic = NULL returns values topics listed . Valid values item: "RGES" (Gesetzesinitiativen / Legislative Initiatives) "" (Ministerialentwürfe / Ministerial Drafts) "BI" (Bürgerinitiativen / Citizens' Initiatives) "PET" (Petitionen / Petitions) "SN" (Stellungnahmen / Statements) Setting item = NULL returns values review types listed . Valid values initiative_type (item=="RGES"): "" (Gesetzesanträge von Abgeordneten / Legislative Motions Members) "BUA" (Gesetzesanträge von Ausschüssen / Legislative Motions Committees) "RV" (Regierungsvorlagen / Government Bills) Setting initiative_type = NULL returns values initiative types listed . Valid values statement_type (item=="SN"): "SNME" (Stellungnahme Ministerialentwurf / Statement Ministerial Draft) "SN" (Stellungnahme Gesetzesinitiative / Statement Legislative Initiative) "SPET" (Stellungnahme zur Petition / Statement Petition) "SPET-BR" (Stellungnahme zur Petition Bundesrat / Statement Petition Federal Council) "SBI" (Stellungnahme Bürgerinitiative / Statement Citizens' Initiative) Setting statement_type = NULL returns values statement types listed .

text: function argument session_and_activities allows three different inputs: sessions: Returns details plenary sessions held. submitted: Returns details submissions made plenary sessions. held: Returns details type sessions held plenary sessions. Possible values submitted session_and_activities set submitted: AA: Abänderungsanträge (Amendment Motions) G037: Anträge auf Absetzung von der Tagesordnung (Motions Remove Agenda) G080: Anträge auf Durchführung einer Volksabstimmung (Motions Referendum) J: Dringliche Anfragen (Urgent Inquiries) AE: Dringliche Anträge (Urgent Motions) G015: Fristerstreckungsanträge (Deadline Extension Motions) G014: Fristsetzungsanträge (Deadline Setting Motions) AB: Kurze Debatten über Anfragebeantwortungen (Brief Debates Inquiry Responses) G053: Rückverweisungsanträge (Referral Back Motions) UEA: Unselbständige Entschließungsanträge (Dependent Resolution Motions) UEAM: Unselbständige Misstrauensanträge (Dependent -Confidence Motions) Possible values held session_and_activities set held: ASEU: Aktuelle Europastunden (Current Europe Hours) : Aktuelle Stunden (Current Hours) GO04: Erklärungen des Präsidenten / der Präsidentin (President Declarations) FS: Fragestunden (Question Hours) RGER: Regierungserklärungen (Government Declarations) RGEU: Regierungserklärungen zu EU-Themen (Government Declarations EU Topics) GO: Sonstige Geschäftsordnungsangelegenheiten (Procedural Matters) GO35: Unterrichtungen gemäß Art. 50 Abs. 5 B-VG (Notifications according Art. 50 Para. 5 B-VG)

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Basic usage: Get sessions for National Council, legislative periods 20-27 sessions_20_27 <- get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "NR",   legis_period = seq(20, 27),   session_and_activities = "sessions",   echo = TRUE )  # Get activities submitted during sessions get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "NR",   legis_period = 27,   session_and_activities = "submitted" )  # Get specific type of submitted activities (urgent inquiries) get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "NR",   legis_period = 27,   session_and_activities = "submitted",   submitted = "J" )  # Get activities held during sessions get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "NR",   legis_period = 27,   session_and_activities = "held",   held = "FS" )  # Federal Council sessions get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "BR",   legis_period = 28,   session_and_activities = "sessions" )  # Multiple legislative periods get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "NR",   legis_period = c(26, 27),   session_and_activities = "sessions" )  # All periods from 20th onwards (NULL legis_period) get_plenary_sessions(   institution = "NR",   legis_period = NULL,   session_and_activities = "sessions" ) } # }

title: Retrieve Transcripts from the Austrian Parliament API — get_transcripts
text: search_string Optional character string filter transcripts keywords. Defaults NULL. legis_period Legislative period(s). Default NULL queries legislative periods. Accepts numeric (10), character ("10") roman numerals character format ("X") well "KN" (Konstituierende Nationalversammlung) "PN" (Provisorische Nationalversammlung). session_type Optional character string specifying type(s) session. Permissible values "NRSITZ" (National Council - Plenary sessions) "BRSITZ" (Federal Council - Plenary sessions). Defaults NULL, queries NRSITZ BRSITZ. See Details information. date_start Optional start date filtering transcripts. Defaults NULL. Date dmy-format (e.g. "01.05.2020", "01/05/2020", "01-05-2020", "01052020"). date_end Optional end date filtering transcripts. Defaults NULL. Date dmy-format (e.g. "01.05.2020", "01/05/2020", "01-05-2020", "01052020"). echo Logical. TRUE, function prints used search parameters url pertaining search results website Austrian Parliament. Default NULL. export Optional character string enable PDF downloads. Set "pdf" download transcript PDFs. Defaults NULL (export). export_destination Character string specifying directory path PDFs saved. Defaults "transcripts" (folder current working directory). folder exist, user prompted create interactive sessions.
